nodes.description: Public address state variable holding the contract owner; set to msg.sender in owned() constructor.
Mapping (uint8 => address) storing enrolled players indexed by entry number.
uint8 counter of enrolled players; incremented in enroll and reset in startOver.
LotteryState enum (Accepting/Finished) tracking lottery lifecycle.
uint8 public max number of players, default 55; configurable by onlyOwner.
uint minimum enrollment value (20000000000000000 wei); configurable by onlyOwner.
Constructor of owned; assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that assigns a new address to owner.
Constructor of MMaker; sets state = LotteryState.Accepting.
Payable enrollment: requires Accepting state and msg.value >= minAmount, increments number, stores msg.sender in players, finishes lottery at maxnumber.
onlyOwner setter for maxnumber.
onlyOwner setter for minAmount.
View returning current number and the address of players[number].
onlyOwner function that derives a winning number from randomtest and calls distributeFunds.
onlyOwner function looping over players deleting entries, then resets number and state.
Private function transferring balance/10 to owner and remaining balance to players[winningNumber].
Internal random source using keccak256(block.timestamp) and keccak256(players[inter]) modulo number.
msg.sender: caller used for ownership, enrollment and access control checks.
block.timestamp: miner-manipulable value used as randomness seed.
number += 1 in enroll; unchecked uint8 arithmetic can overflow when number reaches 255.
owner.transfer(this.balance/10) external value transfer executed after state is read.
players[winningNumber].transfer(this.balance) external value transfer to an attacker-controlled address; classic reentrancy/DoS surface.
keccak256(block.timestamp)-derived randomness; block.timestamp dependence makes the winner predictable/manipulable.
Parameter of transferOwnership(address newOwner).
Parameter of setMaxNumber(uint8 newNumber).
Parameter of setMinAmount(uint newAmount).
Parameter of distributeFunds(uint8 winningNumber) used to index players.
Local return variable in lastPlayer holding the current number.
Local return variable in lastPlayer holding players[number].
Local uint8 in randomtest derived from keccak256(block.timestamp) % number.
uint8 loop counter in startOver iterating over players.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the owner state variable in the owned() constructor.
msg.sender is stored into the players mapping during enroll.
enroll is invoked by an arbitrary msg.sender and gates logic on msg.value.
enroll performs number += 1, the unchecked uint8 increment operation.
The incremented counter value is written back into the number state variable.
The number state variable is used as modulo denominator in the timestamp randomness computation.
transferOwnership takes newOwner as argument under the onlyOwner modifier.
newOwner is assigned to the owner state variable.
setMaxNumber is onlyOwner and accepts newNumber.
newNumber is written into the maxnumber state variable.
setMinAmount is onlyOwner and accepts newAmount.
newAmount is written into the minAmount state variable.
determineWinner is guarded by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender to owner.
startOver is guarded by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender to owner.
determineWinner calls randomtest to obtain the winning number.
determineWinner forwards the winning number to distributeFunds.
block.timestamp is hashed with keccak256, making randomness miner-manipulable.
randomtest relies on the timestamp-derived randomness operation.
randomtest computes the local inter from the timestamp hash modulo number.
winningNumber parameter is supplied by the onlyOwner caller and drives fund distribution.
winningNumber indexes players and its address receives the remaining balance via transfer.
distributeFunds executes external owner.transfer call before finishing logic.
distributeFunds executes external transfer to an attacker-influenced player address.
The winner transfer reads the players mapping to resolve the destination address.
distributeFunds reads the owner state variable as transfer recipient.
startOver deletes entries from the players mapping.
startOver resets the number counter to zero.
startOver iterates using the local loop variable i up to number.
startOver resets the lottery state back to Accepting.
lastPlayer reads players[number] from the players mapping.
lastPlayer returns the local _number return variable.
lastPlayer returns the local _Player return variable.
enroll requires msg.value >= minAmount, coupling caller-supplied value with the threshold.
enroll reads minAmount in its require check on msg.value.
enroll reads maxnumber to bound the enrollment counter.
enroll requires state == LotteryState.Accepting.
enroll sets state to Finished when number reaches maxnumber.
MMaker constructor initializes state to Accepting.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner exists solely as the argument of transferOwnership and is consumed to overwrite the owner state variable.
newNumber is a single-use parameter that only feeds the maxnumber state variable inside setMaxNumber.
newAmount is a single-use parameter that only feeds the minAmount state variable inside setMinAmount.
winningNumber is a private helper parameter used only to index players for the external transfer in distributeFunds.
_number is the return slot of lastPlayer and has no independent behavior.
_Player is the return slot of lastPlayer and has no independent behavior.
inter is a temporary computed inside randomtest used only to index players for the randomness hash.
i is the loop counter of startOver used only to delete players entries.
